claim_being_audited: The Actor's effective claim is that the model can be certified for the current release, based on aggregate readiness and rehearsal results, with reliance on updated disclosure as the intended governance basis.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Material segment weaknesses for named launch use cases must be disclosed before launch unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring notes may provide context but do not satisfy the current-release documentation or mitigation requirement.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release model-card or equivalent release documentation showing the aviation maintenance triage limitation is explicitly disclosed.
Provide approved pre-launch risk acceptance or reviewed mitigation covering the current subgroup regression.
Provide current-release certification/approval records tied to the present retrieval configuration and eval batch.
specific_concerns: Admissible evidence shows a current material segment weakness in the aviation maintenance triage slice.
Policy requires current-release disclosure of material limitations for named launch use cases unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
The record contains no attached reviewed mitigation, approved risk acceptance, or current disclosure language covering the regression.
Prior approval is stale relative to the current retrieval configuration change and eval batch, so it cannot substitute for current-release support.
The informal post-launch monitoring comment is not admissible support for policy satisfaction because it is not reviewed mitigation or approved acceptance.
unsupported_claims: That certification is currently supportable on the available record.
That the current release documentation already reflects the required current evaluation state and material limitation disclosure.
That prior approval or informal monitoring can supply the missing current-release governance predicate.
